meta_description: Victoria Decorators Ltd, Liverpool painter and decorator. Interior and exterior work, wallpapering, and full refurbishment. Free quotes. Call 07900 576308.
hero_subhead: Professional painting and decorating that brings your home or business to life — from a single room to a complete renovation.
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to exterior protection, we handle every aspect of painting and decorating work with attention to detail and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your living spaces with quality emulsion, gloss, and feature wall treatments. We prepare surfaces properly and deliver a clean, lasting finish to every room.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your home's exterior with durable masonry paint and weatherproof coatings. We work in all conditions and scaffold-hire complex facades.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging, feature walls, and textured finishes. We match patterns precisely and remove old coverings to leave walls flawless.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Paint doors, skirting, fascias, and bespoke joinery to the highest standard. We prime, undercoat, and finish for durability and a showroom appearance.

services.title: Full Home Refurbishment
services.desc: End-to-end decoration projects including plastering, repairs, and multi-room coordination. We manage timescales and keep disruption to a minimum.

services.title: Commercial & Contract Work
services.desc: Offices, retail, and landlord renewals handled efficiently on schedule. We carry public liability insurance and work flexibly around your business hours.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own. That's why our customers keep coming back.
about_para_1: Victoria Decorators Ltd was established over 15 years ago with one aim: to deliver honest, skilled decorating work at fair prices. We've built our reputation across Liverpool through meticulous preparation, attention to detail, and reliable timekeeping. Every job—whether a single bedroom or a full commercial refurb—gets the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers appreciate that we listen, plan properly, and finish on time. We're not cowboys: we prep surfaces correctly, source quality materials, and stand behind our work. Many of our jobs come from recommendations and repeat clients who know we'll do the job right.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Mark and the team were tidy, professional, and finished ahead of schedule. The walls look perfect and they cleaned up after themselves—not something you always get. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our whole exterior painted before winter. They took care around the windows and guttering, didn't leave any mess on the driveway, and the finish is excellent. Not the cheapest quote, but you get what you pay for.
reviews.author: Janet H.

reviews.text: Two feature walls and new skirting in our hallway. Victoria Decorators took time to get the colour spot on and the wallpaper is hung perfectly. Friendly lads, professional throughout. Will definitely call them for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: Michael R.
